_readme: Gold query set for NID retrieval eval, following the BDRIS/e-Return pattern. Hybrid strictness: expected_id set means the exact record must appear in top-K (used for fee amounts, specific rules, and other cases where a same-category-but-wrong-record hit would give a factually wrong answer — e.g. the wrong fee amount); expected_id=null means category-level match is the honest bar (used where several records in a category legitimately overlap, e.g. the many short correction-FAQ entries). min_similarity is a soft floor — falling short WARNS, not FAILS. Includes one out-of-scope probe. Built from the full nid.jsonl content (106 records, 10 categories). Calibration pass applied after the first full clean eval: fixed gq_003's category label (its expected record lives in corrections, not fees), corrected the swapped probe encodings on gq_012 (observational) and gq_018 (out-of-scope), and made gq_007 category-level to match its own stated intent (one of its two candidate records, 23f50f349df82565, was merged away). Remaining FAILs are genuine retrieval findings (thin banglish/Bangla coverage; dedicated FAQ/rule records outranked by vocabulary-adjacent records), deliberately left failing rather than masked.

queries.query: What documents do I need for Form-2 enrollment as a new voter?
আমার আইডি কার্ড হারিয়ে গেছে এবং তথ্যও ভুল আছে, একসাথে ঠিক করা যাবে কি?
queries.note: targets a specific sequencing rule (lost card must be reissued BEFORE correction can be filed) — a wrong-but-adjacent correction record would give factually wrong guidance here

queries.query: amar card hariye gese, notun card pete koto taka lagbe first time?
queries.note: expected record 9260a976f7fcb9e9 (lost/damaged reissue, first-time ২০০ taka) is filed under corrections, not fees — category label corrected. Kept record-level because it's a fee-amount fact (a wrong same-category record gives the wrong money). Currently an honest FAIL: banglish phrasing does not surface the reissue-fee record (known bge-m3 banglish limitation), not an eval bug.

queries.query: What are the special document requirements for voter registration in border districts like Cox's Bazar or Bandarban?
queries.note: targets the special-area screening content — genuinely distinct from ordinary Form-2 requirements, a wrong match here would miss the extra grandfather/relative-chain verification entirely

queries.note: hard/adversarial, category-level by design — tests that address-verify queries resolve to the verification category. Originally listed two candidate records; one (23f50f349df82565, the address-validation wizard step) was later merged into 49269d28f061649a and deleted, so this is now a pure category-level check.

queries.query: who can attest my correction application's supporting documents?

Not treated as hard-fail either way; used to observe whether both/either surface, informing whether the corpus has an unintentional duplicate worth deduplicating later
